purpose: Ayat the adult reads aloud in the diagnostic: from medium surahs that most adults have not memorized, with madd, ghunnah and qalqalah. Same procedure as data/quran_fatiha.json: the text is copied from the Madinah Mushaf (King Fahd Complex) and checked against it by hand; an ayah is shown only when text_ar, verified_by and verified_on are all filled in.
source: مصحف المدينة النبوية — مجمع الملك فهد لطباعة المصحف الشريف (رواية حفص عن عاصم)
